text: This report seeks authority to enter into 10-year nominal sublease / lease agreements (collectively the “Agreements”) with the following child care operators: (1) Canadian Mothercraft Society as subtenant at 15 York Garden Way; (2) Child Development Institute as subtenant at 135 Kyle Lowry Road; and (3) Red Apple Day Care (Overlea) as tenant at 8450 Sheppard Avenue East, for the purpose of delivering child care services at newly constructed child-care centres. The child care centres at 15 York Garden Way and 135 Kyle Lowry Road are located in condominium buildings while the child care centre at 8450 Sheppard Avenue East is located in the North East Scarborough Community Recreation Centre.
